description:
Last state (with circuit, the browser's components and wires), last compilation and the events after since_ms
    (2000 at most). `serial` is the full serial output of the current run (up to 16 KiB), reset at each compile and
    NOT starved by pin events: prefer it over reconstructing serial from `events`. During a turn on a real bench,
    `serial` and the serial events come from the bench's board (since the turn began or the last compile), `t` on
    the turn's clock. In challenge mode: the level's brief and its results. circuit_modified: the circuit differs from
    the setup sheet's (types, ids, properties, wires; not positions or colours), null when unknown. circuit_error: the
    editor's last refusal of a pushed circuit, returned once.
name: read_simulation
title: Read the simulation
